title: Sum of Two Integers Without Arithmetic Operators
description: Given two integers `a` and `b`, return the sum of the two integers without using the operators `+` and `-`.
input_format: A single line containing integers `a` and `b`.
hints: Half adder logic: `sum_bits = a ^ b` and `carry_bits = (a & b) << 1`.
Use 32-bit bitmasking to handle negative numbers in Python.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    a, b = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    mask = 0xffffffff
    while (b & mask) != 0:
        carry = (a & b) << 1
        a = a ^ b
        b = carry
    print(a if a <= 0x7fffffff else ~(a ^ mask))
